cases.name: compliance_sentence
cases.text: A record states facts; it never establishes compliance with a framework.

cases.name: served_exception
cases.text: Not met, excepted: EX-12, requested by Sam Ortiz, approved by A. Lee, in force at 2026-11-20T09:15:00.000Z by the server's clock, until 2027-01-31.

cases.name: project_exception
cases.text: Not met, excepted by the project's own file: LOCAL-3; the file names platform-team as approver, which nothing checks; until 2026-12-31.

cases.name: suppression_covered_by_an_exception
cases.text: Not checked: suppressed in the source, covered by the project's exception LOCAL-4.

cases.name: suppression_covered_by_no_exception
cases.text: Not checked: suppressed in the source, covered by no exception.

cases.name: near_miss_expired
cases.text: Not met. Exception EX-12 expired on 2026-10-01.

cases.name: near_miss_not_yet_in_force
cases.text: Not met. Exception EX-13 is not yet in force: it starts on 2026-12-01.

cases.name: near_miss_another_environment
cases.text: Not met. Exception EX-14 is for the environment staging, not production.

cases.name: near_miss_no_environment
cases.text: Not met. Exception EX-15 is for the environment production, and the run names no environment.

cases.name: near_miss_another_version
cases.text: Not met. Exception EX-16 was approved for another version of this assertion.

cases.name: near_miss_approved_later
cases.text: Not met. Exception EX-17 was approved at 2026-11-20T10:00:00.000Z, after the stage's reference time 2026-11-20T09:15:00.000Z.

cases.name: every_failure_excepted
cases.text: Not met, every failure excepted: the gate let the pipeline go on.

cases.name: advisory_let_through
cases.text: Advisory: the gate let the pipeline go on despite results not met or undecided: 3 not met, 1 undecided.

cases.name: incomplete_stopped
cases.text: Incomplete: a required check was not made or its evaluator failed, so the gate stopped the pipeline, even in advisory mode.

cases.name: trust_level_policy_enforced
cases.text: The server that opened the run accepted this record and signed for it: a run statement it signed with a trusted key lists this record. This says the server accepted the record, not that the change met its checks.

cases.name: trust_level_local_run
cases.text: A local run, opened by the CLI, not by a server: only the record's writer vouches for it, and no server signs for it.

cases.name: signed_by_iltero
cases.text: The run statement is signed by Iltero's key iltero-run-statements-2026; the list of trusted keys checked has the digest sha256:137190538f14ad01e1c691ce3a2fa94063b308f5c5d3f9cd6d4eaffc51b82b31.

cases.name: signed_by_an_operator
cases.text: The run statement is signed by Example Corp's server, key example-run-statements-1, which the operator trust file ops/trust.json lists (sha256:137190538f14ad01e1c691ce3a2fa94063b308f5c5d3f9cd6d4eaffc51b82b31); Iltero did not sign it.

cases.name: result_status_word
cases.text: The assertion does not hold for this subject.

cases.name: status_reason
cases.text: A value it reads is only known after the deployment.

cases.name: status_reason_group
cases.text: A fact the rule needs was not supplied.

cases.name: verdict_reason
cases.text: Every required check that failed is covered by an exception the server served the run; the checks still did not pass.

cases.name: process_outcome_stopped
cases.text: The stage stopped before it could judge the change: a usage, input, integrity or connection problem.

cases.name: property_result_run_abandoned
cases.text: The run was abandoned on 2026-11-21T08:00:00.000Z, and 2 of the results it required were never answered.

cases.name: property_result_without_a_reason
cases.text: One record cannot show deployments that left no record; that needs a list of deployments.

cases.name: value_with_braces_is_shown_as_it_is
cases.text: Not checked: suppressed in the source, covered by the project's exception {approver}.

cases.name: value_outside_ascii
cases.text: Not met, excepted by the project's own file: LOCAL-5; the file names Zoë Müller as approver, which nothing checks; until 2027-02-28.

cases.name: unknown_placeholder_refused
cases.refused: the sentence has no placeholder named approver

cases.name: missing_placeholder_refused
cases.refused: the sentence needs a value for its placeholder expires_at

cases.name: value_with_a_new_line_refused
cases.refused: the value for exception holds a control character, which a sentence never shows

cases.name: empty_value_refused
cases.refused: the value for exception is empty, and a sentence never shows a gap
